newsitem.title: UK: Lehman Brothers leads 1.5 bln Ffr securitised bond.
newsitem.headline: Lehman Brothers leads 1.5 bln Ffr securitised bond.

text.p: Belenus Securities Plc has issued a six-tranche bond for 1.5 billion French francs, lead manager Lehman Brothers International (Europe) said on Monday.
The notes are secured by a portfolio of French commercial mortgage loans originated by UIC-SOFAL.
Payment date is December 12 and the notes will be listed in Luxembourg.
Class A notes total 585.7 million French francs and have a legal maturity of November 2014, with an expected final maturity of May 1999.
They will pay a coupon of three-month PIBOR plus 25 basis points will issue price of par and reoffer price of 99.94.
Expected Moody/S&P rating is Aa1/AA. Fees total 15 b.p.
Class B notes total 215.8 million French francs and have a legal maturity of November 2014, with an expected final maturity of November 2000.
They will pay a coupon of three-month PIBOR plus 65 basis points will issue price of par and reoffer price of 99.88.
Class C notes total 154.1 million French francs and have a legal maturity of November 2014, with an expected final maturity of July 2002.
They will pay a coupon of three-month PIBOR plus 125 basis points will issue price of par and reoffer price of 99.02.
Class D, E and F notes for a total of 585.7 million French francs were placed privately.
